title: HireMe
description: Job search command centre: funnel, priorities and activity in one view. Turns a fragmented multi-tab process into a structured pipeline with clear next actions.
problem: Job search work fragments fast: roles scattered across tabs, applications half-tracked in spreadsheets, no signal on priorities or where the real opportunities are.
system: One dashboard for the whole funnel: saved, applied, interview pipeline, and offers. Activity log, priority filters, and status tracking in a single operator view.
artifact: Progressive web app running in the app workspace. Designed and shipped in one sprint as a focused single-JTBD tool.
outcome: A scattered job search becomes a structured pipeline. Every active application visible, prioritised, and tracked without a spreadsheet.
